records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. SEPTEMBER 30, 2025
records.text: •SaaS and license revenue increased 10% to $175.4 million during the three months ended September 30, 2025 from $159.3 million during the three months ended September 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. SEPTEMBER 30, 2025
records.text: SaaS and license revenue represented 68% of our revenue during each of the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025, respectively, as compared to 66% and 67% in the same periods in the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. SEPTEMBER 30, 2025
records.text: Software license revenue represented 2% of our revenue during each of the three and nine months ended September 30, 2025 and 2024.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. SEPTEMBER 30, 2025
records.text: The purchase price allocation was not finalized as of the date of this Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q and is pending the final determination of the working capital adjustment as well as tax adjustments.

records.title: 10-Q ALARM.COM HOLDINGS, INC. SEPTEMBER 30, 2025
records.text: For the nine months ended September 30, 2025, cash flows from operating activities were $117.4 million, compared to $150.2 million for the same period in the prior year.
